comment: The manual says the channel volume uses the tapered response of the AS mixer, but the composite multiplies by the knob value directly, with no taper lookup, so the line follows the code. The mute CV here has a single 2V threshold with no hysteresis and no toggle mode, unlike the Form mixer. Panel labels are drawn at runtime and are not in the panel artwork; they were read from the widget source.
